// Acceptance tests for matchertext literals. They build only with the patched
// toolchain (see ../../build.sh); experiment.sh copies this file to mlit_test.go.
package mlit

import (
	M"fmt"
	"testing"
)

// The import alias M directly before a quote keeps its meaning.
var sprint = M.Sprint

const regex = M"(\b,"axis":(\d+)\b)"

func TestValues(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct{ got, want string }{
		{M"()", ""},
		{M"(a"b)", "a\"b"},
		{M"(\d+)", `\d+`},
		{M"[x(y)z]", "x(y)z"},
		{M"{a{b}c}", "a{b}c"},
		{M"("quoted" (nested [ok] {yes}))", "\"quoted\" (nested [ok] {yes})"},
		{M"(`backtick`)", "`backtick`"},
		{M"(two
lines)", "two\nlines"},
		{regex, "\\b,\"axis\":(\\d+)\\b"},
		{sprint(M"(x)"), "x"},
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		if c.got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("case %d: got %q, want %q", i, c.got, c.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestSwitch(t *testing.T) {
	switch "(a)" {
	case M"[(a)]":
	default:
		t.Error("switch on a matchertext literal did not match")
	}
}
